name: Claude Dev Standards
description: Universal Development Standards (v2.3.0) — A Claude Code skill that enforces production-grade engineering practices across the full SDLC.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `dev-standards`.

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-dev-standards@claude-community` from `Nsyamala1/claude-dev-standards`.

When invoked, this skill instructs Claude to apply a comprehensive set of development standards to everything it generates or reviews in that session — covering code quality, security, performance, API design, testing, DevOps, and more.
